verdict.rationale: Stripe Financial Connections documents specific webhook events (account linked, balance/ownership/transaction refresh completed) that any integrator, including AI-native agent backends, can subscribe to for event-driven workflows. This is standard first-party webhook documentation but lacks AI-specific framing or independent corroboration of agentic webhook consumption. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of AI agents consuming these webhooks, and explicit agent-oriented event subscription guidance.
